blocks.text: Healthy indulgence just got a major upgrade. Kenny Rogers Roasters is shaking up the menu with a crowd-pleasing classic turned all the way up: the all-new Garlic Parmesan Roast. Imagine the brand’s legendary rotisserie-roasted chicken infused with savory garlic and rich parmesan cheese, generously drizzled with buttery, velvety Garlic Parmesan Sauce. A Flavor Bomb That Hits Every Goal At the heart of this limited-time menu is the signature Garlic Parmesan Roast, marinated to juicy perfection and served alongside that extra-decadent garlic-cheese sauce.
